description:
## Goal

Preserve a changed cumulative-contribution withdrawal's typed movement direction from the authoritative removal point through fact change and scheduler dispatch.

A changed withdrawal is a ground shift even when other publishers keep the aggregate present. Equal withdrawal is no content movement and wakes no current reader.

## Current defect

`ContributionMap` can remove one publisher and narrow a still-present aggregate, but `FactTable` reports only the new revision. Scheduler dispatch then guesses direction from fact presence, the completing job's rebase flag, and cumulative/replacing kind, misclassifying this descent as an ascent. A reader joins new evidence instead of rebasing away evidence derived from the old wider ground.

Revision topology cannot recover whether `Some(n) -> Some(n+1)` came from an upsert or withdrawal. The point that performs the authoritative removal must carry that typed movement through completion.

## Strategy and TDD

Extend the existing fact-change path with the smallest typed movement distinction needed by dispatch. Do not introduce analysis withdrawal, a support store, a new queue, or a termination policy here.

Prove at scheduler and real `ActivationInputs` World altitude:

- removing one of two unequal publishers leaves the fact present, advances its revision, wakes its current reader with `shift=true`, and rebases it;
- cumulative insertion/widening remains an ascent;
- equal withdrawal emits no content wake;
- last contentful withdrawal remains a shift;
- bottom presence/retraction preserves its existing non-content semantics;
- telemetry reports the scheduler's authoritative classification.

Existing cumulative, replacing, settlement, determinism, library, CLI, and fixture gates pass. Any metric change must be explained as correction of this already-reachable misclassification.

## Boundary

This ticket repairs an existing classification bug only. It neither enables `AnalyzeActivation` narrowing nor supplies the termination proof for it. It is a prerequisite of the bounded `ReturnType`/`ActivationInputs` support cutover in `fz-kdt.64`.

Delete direction inference made obsolete by the typed movement and correct fact-engine documentation. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes one commit and close.

comments.text: RIDER (fz-kdt.106 landed, a010532e8, 2026-09-01): still open and still gating fz-kdt.64. title: Propagate cumulative withdrawals as typed ground shifts
